title: Teaching young players
summary: Lawrence says he gave most of the young musicians he named their start, including the Hall boys and Herbert Trish.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: A few more things I want to ask you. You want something? Maybe just a little bit. Alright, let's see. I was going to ask you, how many people did you teach? Did you teach a lot of music?
Well, most of them gave them a start, you know. They gave them a start and delicate play. Oh, I guess, in fact, all those that I named, those young fellows there.
You say you helped Kit Thomas' daddy, huh?

Well, that's way after. That's after he stopped playing. I don't count that because it was way after he stopped playing. He liked music and I used to come around. Well, they were the Hall boys. The Herbert Hall. New Earl Robert. The Herbert Hall. And Herbert Trish. And Roland Arcelor. All the boys after they started working. They were getting started music. And after they began to read, then they just went out for themselves. After they moved to the division and then the spell and the lead.
